subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: After the missing-entry marker bug is fixed, should this PR be the canonical Mattermost thread-history recovery fix, and is one bounded server thread fetch per stored session acceptable?
rationale: The code defect is mechanically repairable, but the final landing decision owns a session-state and inbound availability tradeoff and must choose between this PR and the open sibling candidate.

options.title: Repair And Canonicalize This PR
options.body: Fix the missing-entry marker edge case, refresh against main, and use this proof-sufficient branch as the canonical fix.

options.title: Pick The Sibling Candidate
options.body: Fresh-review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93243 instead if maintainers prefer that implementation shape, then close this PR only after the sibling is viable or merged.

options.title: Pause For Owner Direction
options.body: Hold both candidates until a Mattermost/session owner chooses the permanent recovery semantics and inbound fetch budget.

recommendation.title: Repair And Canonicalize This PR
recommendation.body: Fix the missing-entry marker edge case, refresh against main, and use this proof-sufficient branch as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision crosses shared inbound history semantics and plugin session-store behavior where steipete has recent history.
